description: The Pure Data distribution of FluCoMa, a toolbox of Fluid Corpus Manipulation objects for decomposing, analyzing, and organizing sound corpora. Its official Pd installation documentation points to releases from flucoma/flucoma-pd.

research.notes: The package folder is named FluidCorpusManipulation, while the official implementation repository is flucoma-pd; this distinguishes it from the separate Max and SuperCollider repositories.
